checks.name: build-ios26
checks.run: xcodegen generate --quiet && xcodebuild -scheme CenterSpot -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPad Pro 13-inch (M5),OS=26.5' -quiet build
checks.fast: echo 'iOS 26.5 iPad build runs in full before each commit (D-32)'

checks.name: test
checks.run: xcodegen generate --quiet && xcodebuild -scheme CenterSpot -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 18 Pro,OS=27.0' -quiet test

checks.name: no-library-name
checks.run: if git grep -I -n -i -E 'm[o]bbin' -- . ; then echo 'The design reference library is named above. Say "the reference library" instead (Meridian lesson, D-12).'; exit 1; fi
